policy: Evidence levels are set to true only when the evidence exists. software_tested means automated tests for the capability's software path exist in backend/tests and run on synthetic data or upstream documentation fixtures; it says nothing about sensing accuracy. firmware_compiled requires a build with the pinned ESP-IDF for a real target. hardware_tested requires a recorded run on real ESP32 boards. through_wall_validated requires the through-wall validation protocol (roomsense/validation/protocol.py) to have been completed behind a real wall with a report. Runtime state never upgrades these flags; only an edit to this file, backed by the named evidence, does.

notes: Parser, counter/timestamp unwrapping, frame building and source handling are covered by automated tests on upstream esp-csi documentation fixtures and synthetic frames only.

would_change.software_tested: Backed by the test files matching software_test_globs; set to false if they are removed or no longer pass.
would_change.firmware_compiled: Set to true only after firmware/esp32 is built with the pinned ESP-IDF for a real target and the build log is kept.
would_change.hardware_tested: Set to true only after LIVE acquisition from real ESP32 boards is recorded (hello records, frame rates, drop counters) and the recording is kept.
would_change.through_wall_validated: Not applicable to acquisition on its own; stays false.

notes: Windowing, quality, features, baseline and hysteresis logic are covered by automated tests on synthetic data. Passing tests show the code paths run, not that motion is detected reliably in a real room.

would_change.software_tested: Backed by the test files matching software_test_globs; set to false if they are removed or no longer pass.
would_change.firmware_compiled: Set to true only when the firmware that produces the measured CSI has been compiled with the pinned ESP-IDF.
would_change.hardware_tested: Set to true only after motion detection has been run on real boards with labelled walk and empty-room sessions and the report (false alarms per hour, event recall) is kept.
would_change.through_wall_validated: Set to true only after the through-wall protocol has been completed behind a real wall and the report shows the target room is distinguishable from the adjacent space.

notes: Dataset building, session-level splitting, training, evaluation against the predefined criteria, the model registry and the predictor gate are covered by automated tests (tests/test_zone*.py) on SYNTHETIC sessions only. Those tests also check that synthetic data can never enable the capability. No zone model has been trained or validated on real measurements, so zone estimation stays DISABLED.

would_change.software_tested: Set to true once tests matching software_test_globs (tests/test_zone*.py) exist and pass on synthetic data; tests/test_capabilities.py checks that every true claim names existing test files.
would_change.firmware_compiled: Set to true only when the firmware that produces the measured CSI has been compiled with the pinned ESP-IDF.
would_change.hardware_tested: Set to true only after a zone model has passed configs/zone_enablement.toml on held-out sessions recorded with real boards, with the evaluation report kept.
would_change.through_wall_validated: Set to true only after that model has also been evaluated behind a real wall per the validation protocol.

notes: Only the gate is tested: it stays closed with no model installed, rejects mismatched hardware, wrong hashes, unsafe formats and unvalidated models. No pose model exists for this hardware (docs/MODEL_COMPATIBILITY.md).

would_change.software_tested: Backed by backend/tests/test_pose_*.py, which test the gate and the experimental-output interface only.
would_change.firmware_compiled: Not applicable while no pose model exists; stays false.
would_change.hardware_tested: Set to true only after a compatible model with safe-format weights has been evaluated on real boards on an independent (session/person/day) test set, with the report kept.
would_change.through_wall_validated: Set to true only after such a model has been evaluated behind a real wall; stays false.
